description: Frontend: Display stock warnings in Excel import preview (separate OK and warning sections with override checkboxes), single-row add/edit forms (inline warning on Order Qty blur with acknowledgment checkbox), and list view (⚠️ indicator badge for rows with warnings). Integrates with backend validation endpoints.
steps: Modify ImportExcelModal.jsx: Add state for stockWarnings and stockWarningOverrides. After preview response, parse stockWarnings array. Render summary card showing 'OK Stock: X | Over Stock: Y'. Split date tab display into two sections: okStockRows table and warningStockRows table. For warning rows, show columns: Order Qty, Available Stock, Over By (in red). Add override checkbox per warning row. On commit, collect checked overrides and send to backend in stockWarningOverrides object.

Modify AddLacquerPlan.jsx: Add state for stockWarnings[index] and acknowledgeStockWarning[index]. Add handleOrderQtyBlur handler: when Order Qty loses focus, if plainBottleId selected, call GET /lacquer-plan/validate-stock API with bottleName, companyId, orderQty. If response hasWarning, store in stockWarnings[index] state and display inline warning UI. Render warning card below Order Qty field showing order qty, available stock, breakdown, and checkbox. In form submit validation, check if any row has stockWarning without acknowledgeStockWarning set, show error and block submit. Pass stockWarningAcknowledged: acknowledgeStockWarning[index] to payload.

Modify EditLacquerPlan.jsx: Same as AddLacquerPlan.jsx but with qty increase detection. In handleOrderQtyBlur, compare newQty with existing plan's oldQty. Only trigger warning if newQty > oldQty. Display delta in warning message: 'Increasing from X to Y (delta: +Z)'. Pass excludeRowId (current row ID) to API call to avoid self-counting in allocation.

Modify LacquerPlan.jsx list view: Add visual indicator for rows with stockWarningAcknowledged === true. Render ⚠️ badge or highlight row with yellow background. On hover, show tooltip with warning details: 'Stock Warning Override: Imported with 400 units over available. Order: 900 | Available: 500 | Acknowledged: 2024-01-15'. Display acknowledgment timestamp if available.
acceptance_criteria: ImportExcelModal preview shows 'OK Stock' and 'Over Stock' sections separated
Excel import warning rows display override checkboxes and over-by amounts
Excel import commit sends stockWarningOverrides to backend
AddLacquerPlan shows inline warning on Order Qty blur when order exceeds available stock
AddLacquerPlan form submit is blocked without acknowledgment checkbox checked
AddLacquerPlan passes stockWarningAcknowledged flag in payload when acknowledged
EditLacquerPlan only shows warning when orderQty is increased, not on decrease or unchanged
EditLacquerPlan displays delta (e.g., '+400') in warning message
EditLacquerPlan calls API with excludeRowId to avoid self-allocation
LacquerPlan list view shows ⚠️ badge for rows with stockWarningAcknowledged: true
LacquerPlan tooltip displays stock warning override details on hover
All warnings formatted consistently with order qty, available stock, total stock, allocated, and breakdown
API error handling: 'STOCK_WARNING_REQUIRED' error properly triggers warning UI instead of creating/updating row
